summary: Delivered the native editor/LSP vertical without forking OXC or moving language work into JavaScript. One canonical OXC stdio server now provides authored-span live diagnostics, Oxfmt formatting, malformed-buffer recovery, optional single-document type diagnostics, and only identity-mapped validation-passed quick fixes. A bundled additive VS Code companion activates on real Markless .tsrx documents, preserves framework ownership, applies live workspace config changes through canonical per-workspace options, and passes a real VS Code 1.128 Extension Host walkthrough against a disposable exact Markless fixture with identical external fingerprints before and after.

architecture.canonical_server: crates/oxc_adapter privately hosts oxc_language_server 1.41.0 at exact canonical revision 8e0ed2ebb96137fb1611cdbd5742d5cb46037d40. No OXC/tower types cross the project-owned EditorTool/EditorToolFactory boundary.
architecture.native_hot_path: One long-lived Rust process owns scan, projection, canonical OXC lint/format, source mapping, UTF-8 byte to UTF-16 conversion, and fix validation. The JavaScript extension only resolves and launches the binary and transports LSP messages; it contains no TSRX AST or language traversal.
architecture.sessions: Each workspace owns one diagnostics LintSession, one fix-enabled no-write action LintSession, and one FormatSession. Type-aware editor work is explicit, single-document per request, and uses the pinned public TypeScript-Go boundary only when enabled.
architecture.fix_safety: LintSession::code_actions returns only mapped safe edits without writing. Every candidate edit occupies an exact authored identity range and the edited TSRX must pass validation reparse before the server advertises one preferred quickfix. Fix-all, suggestions, and dangerous actions are not advertised.
architecture.settings_lifecycle: The VS Code client sends canonical Vec<WorkspaceOption> payloads at initialize and on relevant workspace settings changes. Generic vscode-languageclient configuration reshaping was removed. A real host test proves an explicit initial config survives and a live config-path switch rebuilds analysis and refreshes diagnostics.
architecture.framework_coexistence: The companion contributes no competing language. Its file-pattern selector attaches to file-backed .tsrx documents and activation recognizes markless-tsrx, ripple, tsrx, and workspaceContains. Tests filter OXC diagnostics by source and permit Markless/TypeScript diagnostics alongside them.
architecture.malformed_source: Invalid in-memory source publishes an authored parse-error and formatting returns no edit; a subsequent valid full-document change restores lint diagnostics.
architecture.distribution_boundary: The source tree builds a bundled VSIX and native arm64 server, but installed platform-native discovery and a self-contained installed VSIX are deliberately deferred to T026 and are not claimed here.
